body.zh-Hant: 1939年3月15日，鐵托自莫斯科返回後組成南共（KPJ）中央委員會；1940年10月19至23日在薩格勒布舉行第五次全國會議，他當選為南共總書記。1941年4月6日軸心國軍隊入侵南斯拉夫，他在4月10日組成軍事委員會，以組織對佔領軍的抵抗。
body.en: On 15 March 1939, after returning from Moscow, Tito constituted the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Yugoslavia (KPJ). The Fifth Land Conference was held in Zagreb on 19–23 October 1940, and he was elected general secretary of the KPJ. After the Axis invasion of Yugoslavia on 6 April 1941, he formed a Military Committee on 10 April to organise resistance to the occupying armies.

body.zh-Hant: 1941年6月27日，他組成GŠ NOPOJ並接任最高司令（vrhovni komandant）職；7月4日南共政治局決定起義，9月16日他離開貝爾格萊德前往塞爾維亞西部的解放區。1942年年中他率主力轉往波斯尼亞西部與克羅埃西亞，在當地建立大片自由領土並編成人民解放軍；11月26至27日在比哈奇成立AVNOJ。
body.en: On 27 June 1941 he formed the GŠ NOPOJ and assumed the function of supreme commander (vrhovni komandant). The Politburo decided on the uprising on 4 July, and on 16 September he left Belgrade for the liberated territory of western Serbia. In mid-1942 he moved the main force to western Bosnia and Croatia, where a large free territory arose and the NOVJ was formed with divisions and corps; AVNOJ was founded at Bihać on 26–27 November 1942.

heading.zh-Hant: 攻勢、元帥與德爾瓦爾空降
heading.en: Offensives, the marshalcy and the Drvar landing

body.zh-Hant: 德、義最高統帥部對他的部隊強加一系列戰役，即所謂第四、第五次攻勢，持續至1943年年中，人民解放軍頂住了攻擊。1943年11月29日第二屆AVNOJ會議任命他為NKOJ主席（具臨時政府地位），並宣布他為南斯拉夫元帥。1944年5月德軍空降德爾瓦爾以圖消滅他，之後他轉往維斯島；6月16日他與蘇巴希奇在維斯島簽署協議。
body.en: The German and Italian supreme commands imposed on his force a series of battles known as the IV and V offensives, lasting from the start to the middle of 1943, which the NOV withstood. At the second AVNOJ session on 29 November 1943 he was appointed president of the NKOJ, with the status of provisional government, and proclaimed Marshal of Yugoslavia. In May 1944 the German command staged a landing at Drvar to destroy him; he then moved to the island of Vis, where on 16 June he and Šubašić signed an agreement.

heading.zh-Hant: 解放貝爾格萊德與臨時政府
heading.en: Liberation of Belgrade and the provisional government

body.zh-Hant: 1944年8月他在義大利與邱吉爾會面，討論戰後南斯拉夫的安排；10月20日貝爾格萊德解放，11月18至19日他自維斯島飛往莫斯科，協調人民解放軍與紅軍的軍事行動。1945年3月7日成立南斯拉夫民主聯邦臨時政府；他以最高司令身分親自參與終局作戰的策劃與執行，並擔任臨時政府主席。
body.en: In August 1944 he met Churchill in Italy and discussed the postwar arrangement of Yugoslavia. Belgrade was liberated on 20 October, and on 18/19 November he flew from Vis to Moscow to coordinate NOV operations with the Red Army. The Provisional Government of the DFJ was created on 7 March 1945. As supreme commander he took part personally in planning and carrying out the final operations, and he served as president of the provisional government.

body.zh-Hant: 1900年普勒托利亞陷落後，史末資加入布耳人的突擊隊，翌年率領部下千里遠征開普殖民地；他是布耳人最出色的軍人之一，也是韋雷尼欣和會的談判代表。1902年他以特蘭士瓦政府法律顧問身分出席該會議。
body.en: After the fall of Pretoria in 1900, Smuts joined the Boer commandos and in the following year led his own troops on a thousand-mile odyssey into the Cape Colony. He was one of the Boers' best soldiers and one of their negotiators at the Vereeniging peace conference, which he attended in 1902 as legal adviser to the Transvaal government.

heading.zh-Hant: 聯邦內閣與德屬西南非
heading.en: Union cabinet and German South West Africa

body.zh-Hant: 1906年特蘭士瓦恢復自治後，他出任博塔自治政府的殖民地次官兼教育部長。1910年南非聯邦成立後他擔任礦業、國防與內政大臣，創建了聯邦國防軍；一戰爆發後組成南非國防軍，1915年他與博塔征服德屬西南非。
body.en: When Transvaal self-government was restored in 1906, he became colonial under-secretary and education minister in the Botha government. After the Union of South Africa was formed in 1910 he served as minister of mines, defence and the interior and created the Union Defence Force. After the First World War broke out he formed the South African Defence Force, and in 1915 he and Botha conquered German South West Africa.

body.zh-Hant: 1916年2月12日，他奉命接掌英國在東非的部隊指揮權，19日抵達蒙巴薩，出任東非帝國軍司令官，指揮征服德屬東非的戰役。他動員大軍卻難以擊敗利托夫—福貝克的游擊部隊，當時有人批評他拖延戰事；1917年1月20日霍斯金斯在東非接掌指揮權，史末資離開東非，前往英國加入帝國戰時內閣。
body.en: On 12 February 1916 he assumed command of the British forces in East Africa, arriving at Mombasa on the 19th, and as commander of the imperial forces in East Africa led the conquest of German East Africa. Despite mobilising a large force he struggled to defeat Lettow-Vorbeck's guerrillas, and some contemporaries criticised him for dragging out the campaign. Hoskins assumed command in East Africa on 20 January 1917, and Smuts left to join the Imperial War Cabinet in Britain.

heading.zh-Hant: 戰後首相與英國陸軍元帥
heading.en: Prime minister and British field marshal

body.zh-Hant: 1919至1924年間他擔任聯邦首相，1934年與赫爾佐格合組統一黨（連合南非國民黨）。二戰爆發後他與主張中立的赫爾佐格對立，1939年再度出任首相並讓南非參戰；1941年他被晉升為英國陸軍元帥。
body.en: He served as prime minister of the Union from 1919 to 1924 and in 1934 formed the United South African National Party with Hertzog. In 1939, when Hertzog's neutrality motion was defeated, he took over as premier again and brought South Africa into the war, and in 1941 he was promoted field marshal of the British Army.

heading.zh-Hant: 留法、立憲革命與國防部長
heading.en: Study in France, the 1932 revolution and the defence ministry

body.zh-Hant: 1924年起他赴法國留學約三年，其間與比里等人組成以推翻絕對君主制為目標的政治團體。1932年他以陸軍少校身分參加立憲革命，1934年出任國防部長，與比里領導的文官派對抗；1938年他組成第一次披汶內閣，並把國名由暹羅改為泰國。
body.en: From 1924 he studied in France for about three years, during which he and Pridi and others formed a political group aimed at overthrowing the absolute monarchy. In 1932 he took part in the constitutional revolution as an army major, in 1934 he became defence minister and fought the civilian faction led by Pridi, and in 1938 he formed his first cabinet and changed the country's name from Siam to Thailand.

heading.en: The Franco-Thai war and the alliance with Japan

body.zh-Hant: 1941年1月，他的政府向法國索還領土，日本政府出面調停，日本軍的影響力隨之籠罩政府。1941年底日軍進入泰國；他以總理兼最高司令的身分簽署與日軍合作的協議，並於12月21日簽訂與日本結盟的條約。1942年1月25日泰國向英國與美國宣戰。
body.en: In January 1941 his government demanded the return of territory from France, with the Japanese government mediating, and Japanese military influence began to cover the government. In late 1941 Japanese forces entered Thailand; as prime minister and supreme commander he signed the agreement on military cooperation with Japan, and on 21 December signed the treaty of alliance with Japan. On 25 January 1942 Thailand declared war on Britain and the United States.

heading.en: Wavering resignation and fall from power

body.zh-Hant: 1942年他與日本締結防衛同盟。1943年2月他向攝政團遞出首相辭呈，卻又改變心意、聲明並不辭職，令人民黨（革命團體）成員多有不滿。戰況惡化後，他的政府無法再維持統治，他於1944年失勢。
body.en: In 1942 he concluded a defensive alliance with Japan. In February 1943 he submitted his resignation as prime minister to the regency council but then changed his mind and declared he would not resign, which caused resentment among the members of the Khana Ratsadon. As the war situation worsened his government could no longer carry on, and he fell from power in 1944.
